package config

import (
	"testing"

	"github.com/stretchr/testify/require"
)

func TestTogetherOptions(t *testing.T) {
	opt := DefaultBuildOptions()
	require.False(t, opt.Enabled)
	require.Equal(t, []string{"safe"}, opt.Tags)
	opt.Tags = []string{"invalid"}
	require.NoError(t, opt.Validate(), "individual field validation is skipped for disabled sets")
	WithTags([]string{"fast", "invalid"})(opt)
	require.True(t, opt.Enabled)
	require.Error(t, opt.Validate(), "each list item must obey its enum")
	WithTags([]string{"fast", "safe"})(opt)
	require.NoError(t, opt.Validate())

	cloned := opt.Clone()
	cloned.Tags[0] = "safe"
	require.Equal(t, "fast", opt.Tags[0], "clone must not share list storage")
	(*cloned.References)[0] = "changed"
	require.Equal(t, []string{"original"}, *opt.References, "clone must also copy referenced lists")

	WithTracing()(opt)
	require.Error(t, opt.Validate(), "the selected condition requires a label")
	WithLabel("trace")(opt)
	WithProfile("debug")(opt)
	require.NoError(t, opt.Validate())
	WithoutTracing()(opt)
	require.True(t, opt.Enabled, "a negative boolean helper still selects the set")
	require.Error(t, opt.Validate(), "cross-field constraints use direct parameter fields")
	WithProfile("")(opt)
	require.NoError(t, opt.Validate())

	WithWindow(80, 24)(opt)
	require.Equal(t, 80, opt.Width)
	require.Equal(t, 24, opt.Height)
	opt.Default()
	require.False(t, opt.Enabled)
	require.Equal(t, []string{"safe"}, opt.Tags)
	require.False(t, opt.Tracing)

	WithTags(nil)(nil)
	WithTracing()(nil)
	WithoutTracing()(nil)
	WithWindow(1, 2)(nil)
	require.Nil(t, (*BuildOptions)(nil).Clone())
	require.NoError(t, (*BuildOptions)(nil).Validate())
}
